### Problem Description
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe clearly (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]").

If proposing a new style metric, heuristic rule, or calibration dimension, please provide any supporting rationale, separation data, or empirical findings.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or examples here.
